question_record.context: A suspicious execution of a command via Impacket was observed on a device with hostname `mb-adfs`. This tool connects to other hosts to explore network shares and execute commands, indicating that attackers might be attempting lateral movement across the network. This activity is often linked to hands-on-keyboard attacks where ransomware and other payloads are installed. During the investigation, multiple files including `powershell.exe` were identified as part of the ongoing attack.
question_record.question: What was the name of the file associated with the suspicious remote activity observed shortly after the impacket execution?
solution: Suspicious execution of a command via the Impacket toolkit was observed with the `%comspec%` file.

Suspicious remote activity was observed involving the `cmd.exe` file which can include attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities.

16.name: Ongoing hands-on-keyboard attack via Impacket toolkit
16.description:
Suspicious execution of a command via Impacket was observed on this device. This tool connects to other hosts to explore network shares and execute commands. Attackers might be attempting to move laterally across the network using this tool. This usage of Impacket has often been observed in hands-on-keyboard attacks, where ransomware and other payloads are installed on target devices.

Corresponding TA for this IOA: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/ff7e4fff-dde3-49be-9a06-7f63a490996d/analystreport

37.name: Suspicious remote activity
37.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'File_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
